new_value: Feature already implemented. The Rust frame.rs (lines 116, 331-346) properly handles V2 signer_iid_present (bit 7) via SIGNER_EUI64_BIT constant added in commit 4c5c4af6cc (Aug 24). The stale binary at rust/target/release/frame-parser (built Jul 19) predates this fix. The test harness at python/tests/sim/test_cross_impl_interop.py lines 84-121 already handles rebuilding when LICHEN_RUN_CROSS_IMPL=1 is set. No code changes required - just rebuild the binary.
